Albert Einstein’s theory of relativity fundamentally changed how we understand the universe by linking space, time, and gravity. It is made up of two parts: special relativity, which is used in particle physics and cosmology, and general relativity, which explains how gravity works. In simple terms, Einstein’s equations show that massive objects like stars and planets bend the fabric of space and time around them. This bending is what we experience as gravity.

The first three months of the year are January, February, and March.
